collection.title: BMW 4 Series Coupe 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 4 Series Coupe 2020 Onwards  requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: BMW 4 Series Coupe 2020 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
